literature.title: The safety and efficacy of high-dose daptomycin combined with rifampicin for the treatment of Gram-positive osteoarticular infections.
literature.abstract: Treatment of Gram-positive osteoarticular infections requires an adequate surgical approach combined with intensive antimicrobial therapy. The aim of this study was to evaluate the safety and efficacy of a combined regimen of high-dose daptomycin and rifampicin, in patients with various types of Gram-positive osteoarticular infections.

literature.abstract: To investigate the clinical efficacy and safety of daptomycin in the treatment of hip and knee periprosthetic joint infections (PJIs).

literature.abstract: To evaluate the clinical characteristics, treatment and outcomes of patients with osteoarticular infections (OAIs) associated with Staphylococcus aureus bacteraemia (SAB).

literature.title: Chronic Corynebacterium striatum Septic Arthritis in a Patient Referred for Total Knee Arthroplasty.
literature.abstract: While Corynebacterium striatum and other Corynebacterium species were historically considered contaminants, they are recently being identified as pathogens with increasing frequency. Case Summary. We report the case of a 78-year-old gentleman with a three-year history of knee pain and established diagnosis of osteoarthritis referred for consideration for total knee arthroplasty. He had no knee pain with passive range-of-motion. Plain films demonstrated bony erosions atypical for osteoarthritis.

literature.title: Microbiologic profile of Staphylococci isolated from osteoarticular infections: evolution over ten years.
literature.abstract: Staphylococci, especially coagulase-negative staphylococci (CoNS) represent the most frequent micro-organism associated with osteoarticular infections (OAIs), especially those involving orthopedic devices. The antibiotic susceptibility profile of the bacteria mostly responsible for OAIs is therefore crucial information for choosing the appropriate antibiotic regimen administered during the removal procedure until the first results of the conventional culture.

literature.abstract: Rheumatoid arthritis (RA) is a systemic autoimmune disease, and a large number of patients do not respond well to existing treatment strategies. literature.title: Surgeon-Specific Infection Rates and Risk Factors for Prosthetic Joint Infections.
literature.journal: Journal of clinical practice and research
literature.abstract: Prosthetic joint infections (PJIs) can lead to extended hospital stays, necessitate additional surgeries, and require antimicrobial treatment, thereby increasing costs and causing significant morbidity. This study aims to ascertain surgeon-specific infection rates and identify risk factors associated with PJIs.

literature.abstract: Methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) infections are one of the most serious surgery complications, and their prevention is of utmost importance. Flufenamic acid is a non-steroid anti-inflammatory drug approved for clinical use to relieve inflammation and pain in rheumatoid arthritis patients. repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 2025年新興機轉假說：兩篇新發表研究（PMID 39571268, 40923559）直接在膠原蛋白誘導性關節炎(CIA)動物模型中驗證Daptomycin的抗炎活性，機轉為抑制NF-κB信號通路，下調TNF-α、IL-1β、IL-6、IL-17等RA核心致病細胞激素。CIA模型為RA藥物開發金標準動物模型，結果具機轉合理性。然而：(1)Daptomycin具肌毒性（CK升高、橫紋肌溶解）及肺毒性風險，不適合慢性病長期給藥；(2)無人體安全性資料；(3)其他4篇文獻與RA治療無直接關聯。整體屬早期動物模型間接證據。

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: OA易感性為多基因遺傳病（GDF5、ALDH1A2、TGFB1等），Daptomycin無任何已知作用於OA遺傳易感通路的機轉。3篇文獻均為PJI感染微生物學研究，與OA易感性修飾完全無關聯。屬osteoarthritis/osteoarticular文字混淆導致的TxGNN偽預測。

literature.title: Daptomycin-induced rhabdomyolysis complicated with acute gouty arthritis.
literature.journal: The American journal of the medical sciences
literature.abstract: Rhabdomyolysis is a well-documented side effect of daptomycin and is associated with hyperuricemia. However, the occurrence of acute gouty arthritis secondary to rhabdomyolysis-induced hyperuricemia has not been reported. We report a case of a patient who presented with daptomycin-induced rhabdomyolysis prior to the usual 7-10-day administration period. This case was complicated with acute gouty arthritis after 7 days from the onset of rhabdomyolysis symptoms. Treatment consisted of fluid manage

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 唯一文獻(PMID 36693494)為Daptomycin誘發橫紋肌溶解症後『繼發性』急性痛風發作的不良反應病例，屬藥物副作用文獻，代表安全疑慮而非治療契機。Daptomycin無降尿酸、抑制黃嘌呤氧化酶或抑制NLRP3炎症小體（痛風核心機轉）的已知機轉。此預測應標記為反向證據。
假性軟骨發育不全症為COMP基因突變導致的遺傳性骨骼發育障礙（軟骨基質蛋白錯誤折疊、內質網壓力累積）。Daptomycin無任何已知作用於COMP蛋白折疊、內質網未折疊蛋白反應(UPR)或軟骨細胞發育通路的機轉。零臨床零前臨床證據，屬純演算法預測假陽性。
Hunter-Thompson型肢端中段肢骨發育不良為CDMP1(GDF5)基因功能喪失突變所致的罕見遺傳性軟骨發育異常。Daptomycin無任何作用於BMP/GDF信號通路的已知機轉。零臨床零前臨床證據，屬TxGNN骨科相關疾病群聚預測假陽性。
脊椎短缺症為PAPSS2、TRPV4等基因突變導致的遺傳性脊椎發育障礙（硫酸蛋白聚糖合成缺陷）。Daptomycin無任何作用於蛋白聚糖硫化、軟骨基質合成或鈣離子通道TRPV4的已知機轉。零臨床零前臨床證據，屬演算法預測假陽性。
短指-並指綜合症為GJA1或相關基因突變的先天性肢端發育異常（胚胎期肢端形態發生缺陷）。Daptomycin無任何已知作用於BMP、Wnt、Hedgehog等肢端形態發生信號通路的機轉，亦無胚胎發育調控作用。零臨床零前臨床證據，屬純演算法預測假陽性。
極罕見先天性眼-骨骼複合發育異常症候群（小眼症+根莖型骨骼發育不良），病因涉及眼杯發育及軟骨骨化相關基因突變。Daptomycin無任何作用於PAX6、STRA6等視覺發育通路或根莖型骨骼發育相關通路的機轉。零臨床零前臨床證據，屬TxGNN骨科疾病知識圖譜鄰近性預測假陽性。
XYLT2基因突變導致的遺傳性骨-牙複合發育缺陷（蛋白聚糖木糖轉移酶缺失→脊椎發育異常+牙釉質礦化障礙）。Daptomycin無任何已知作用於蛋白聚糖生物合成起始步驟、牙釉質基質礦化或XYLT2通路的機轉。零臨床零前臨床證據，屬演算法預測假陽性。
